summary: Build customer interviews, assumption testing, and opportunity mapping skills. Train your team to validate product ideas faster.
lede: Customer research and product discovery help product professionals ground decisions in evidence about customer needs. Designed for product managers, owners, researchers, and designers, the training covers interview planning and facilitation, assumption testing, and opportunity framing. Participants practice turning findings into opportunity maps, prioritized options, and research reports that inform product decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to turn customer insight into product decisions, research outputs, and prioritization choices.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of product development, customer-facing business processes, or digital service delivery. Prior experience with interviews, surveys, or product planning helps, but no coding is required. A basic understanding of product strategy, feature prioritization, and collaborative tools such as Miro, Dovetail, or similar research repositories will support the exercises. For the AI-supported analysis elements, the course assumes comfort using standard digital workspaces and uploading non-sensitive research notes or transcripts into approved tools subject to organizational policy.
